purpose: Present selected-vehicle battery health estimates, historical snapshots, modeled forecasts and confidence bounds, charging-habit stress, risk factors and source-provided recommendations.
primaryGoal: Understand the available telemetry-derived health evidence and its limits, inspect history and forecast uncertainty, and review guidance without issuing vehicle commands.

dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:3877; App.tsx:72,854 confirms lazy SafeRoute mount
dataSources.queryContract: ['battery-health-analytics', vehicleId], enabled only when vehicleId !== null, STALE_TIMES.ANALYTICS, retry:false; queryFn forwards signal to typed request<BatteryHealthAnalytics>. No explicit date bounds, pagination or as-of parameter.
dataSources.trustContract: useDataState provenance=inferred and maxAgeMs=86400000; retained payload and fatal versus refresh errors preserved; independent DataFreshnessAuto forceStaleAfterMs=86400000.
dataSources.limits: Backend handler/repository/serialization and actual aggregate refresh schedule were not inspected. The page comment calls the source a daily cagg, but this audit does not establish that implementation or measured pack capacity. The /analytics/battery-degradation endpoint is not the mounted page's query.

dataSources.contract: First returned history row's range is the constant original-range comparison; current range converts only finite meters. Historical health plus returned projections are concatenated; first projected row receives the last history health to join series. Confidence band=max(0,high-low) stacked over the returned low bound. Fast-charge share uses fast+slow counts only when both exist and sum>0. Cycle-depth score=max(0,round(100-avg_DoD)).
dataSources.limits: Returned ordering, finite/nullable guarantees, forecasting calibration, meaning of the displayed 95% confidence label and the generic 80% warranty reference are not verified. Preserve source inputs and existing calculations; do not fabricate observations or infer degradation damage from absent history.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing workspace, URL series visibility and user formatting owners
dataSources.contract: Header vehicle selector owns scope. getWorkspaceRouteScope('/battery-degradation') is vehicle:true, range:false from workspaceScope.ts:23-78,156-165; page supplies no duplicate scope selector. Stable hidden-series id battery-degradation-trend. Raw Wh and meters remain in query/types; useUnits formatEnergy and convertDistanceFromSI apply saved preferences at display boundary.
dataSources.limits: Hook internals, preference persistence and real navigation scope transitions are not runtime-tested. No new date control or backend filtering capability should be assumed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Loading/fatal-error/empty branches repeat across prediction, habits, range, risk, recommendations and history. Titles are deliberately retained. DegradationGrid and BatteryDegradationStats already extract reusable layout/metric behavior.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Only consolidate feature-level source-state presentation after preserving each distinct empty explanation, retry, chart chrome and specialist content. Do not invent a competing card/state library.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: History cell labels and mobile displayValue repeat distance/SOH/capacity formatting, while range chart follows the same display boundary. Equivalent display logic must stay synchronized.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse bounded feature formatting adapters if needed; retain raw column keys/filter values, displayed units and mobile metadata without converting query/cache values.

sourceConfirmed: PageLayout supplies w-full/min-w-0 and container context; DegradationGrid uses measured CardGrid and placement rather than viewport-only fixed columns.
LayoutCard header wraps and headings break words; help action requests min-h-11/min-w-11.
Risk names break words and icons shrink-0; history mobile cards explicitly retain all five columns.
Range chart has explicit 224px mobile and 288px desktop heights, shared responsive container and distance-unit axis; projection chart requests height=300 and standard size.

issues.detail: Nested health-factor card headers and risk score headers use nowrap flex justify-between plus compact badges; long translations and API risk labels compete for narrow packed card width. MetricBar header also does not wrap. This is an overflow risk, not an observed browser defect.
issues.fix: Test narrow allocated cards at 320/375/390px and text zoom; allow wrapping without omitting label, numeric score, reason or denominator.

responsive.verification: All ten required widths, RTL, zoom, safe-area scroll, long localized labels, narrow desktop allocations and real table-card details remain unverified.

sourceConfirmed: Named section/card groups and shared heading semantics; typography uses Text/Caption rather than raw controls.
Risk and recommendation icons are marked aria-hidden; health gauge has a label, unit and meter implementation; risk tracks have progressbar semantics and visible score text.
Range chart supplies real data/dataColumns enabling shared screen-reader and forced-colors fallback table.
History uses semantic shared DataTable with named row labels and complete mobile roles.
FadeIn and MetricBar consult the existing reduced-motion policy.

issues.detail: Projection caller explicitly opts out with chart-a11y:no-table and supplies neither data/dataColumns nor ariaDescription. ChartContainer then gives only 'Chart: title'. Summary cards and historical table do not expose each future projected value or low/high confidence bound. The ariaLabel alone does not supply equivalent forecast evidence.
issues.fix: Provide a real accessible projection table or full equivalent description through the existing ChartCard contract. Include historical health, projected health and both source confidence bounds; keep null gaps, brush/legend/annotations/export behavior and do not invent forecasts.

issues.detail: Range fallback columns have generic range labels and no format functions; converted numeric rows therefore lack explicit distance units in the shared fallback cells. Visual Y-axis and tooltip do include units.
issues.fix: Include the effective saved distance unit in fallback column labels or format functions using existing formatting; preserve raw SI and converted display geometry.

acceptanceRequired: Keyboard/visible focus for help, review-details drawer, retries, chart export, legend, brush and annotations.
Screen-reader source-trust context, projection alternatives, meter judgement, history filters/pagination and mobile cards.
Effective text/UI contrast in light/dark/custom/forced-colors modes and actual 44px target reachability.
accessibility.verification: No keyboard, browser, screen reader, contrast measurement or viewport session performed.

states.loading: Initial !hasData && healthQuery.isLoading controls summary loading and contextual per-card skeletons; card titles remain. No whole-page data gate.
states.empty: Empty history, range, risk and recommendations have distinct explanations; missing finite SOH gets refresh action. Prediction respects has_enough_data and explains minimum 3 snapshots. History adds governed actionable prerequisites.
states.error: fatalError replaces summary and dependent bodies, while ChartCard receives onRetry=healthState.retry. Other QueryError instances do not receive onRetry.
states.stale: useDataState retains payload across refresh failure/age; top StaleRefreshWarning preserves populated content and has retry. Header freshness requests 24h threshold.
states.offline: Paused initial load shows explicit reconnect notice; retained paused data remains visible with stale notice. Initial paused query can also render unavailable/empty bodies because isLoading is false when not fetching.
states.partial: Single aggregate response, no page-supplied partial/unavailable option. Missing nested values use dashes or individual EmptyStates; absence is not measured zero. Successful aggregate presence is not proof every measurement is available.
states.disabled: No selected vehicle disables hook; page has no explicit no-vehicle branch and renders unavailable/empty sections plus history guidance. No source request or fake measurement should be invented.
states.success: Displays only source-backed values/arrays and existing calculated indices; model estimates remain distinct from direct measurements in summary explanation.

issues.detail: Repeated QueryError calls pass error only; _StatusAwareError exposes retry only when onRetry exists. Shared hook also has retry:false. The projection chart is the only fatal body with explicit retry; other fatal cards omit local recovery.
issues.fix: Pass existing healthState.retry to each applicable QueryError or clearly expose one source-level retry beside all dependent sections. Keep classifier behavior and avoid repeated concurrent refetch controls.

issues.detail: BatteryEvidenceBrief supports retained status, but BatteryDegradationStats forwards neither retained nor trust state. After a failed/paused background refresh, global warning is correct while summary and fit brief can still label retained readings 'Available source readings'.
issues.fix: Forward existing source trust to both briefs using the existing retained prop; keep all metric values and window limitations visible and preserve global warning/retry.

issues.detail: Initial offline pause has a correct explicit notice, but nonloading cards can simultaneously explain missing history/minimum snapshots before a response has established that fact. Disabled no-vehicle query follows similar empty explanations.
issues.fix: Differentiate no-vehicle, initial paused and resolved-empty body messages without hiding any section or simulating data. Reuse governed feedback and workspace scope.

visualIssues.detail: Prediction callout uses neon-purple tinted background/border, and recommendation rows use neon-amber tint at line 618. These are decorative panels rather than necessary measurement encoding.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border tokens with restrained semantic status cues. Keep 80% target, predicted date/years, recommendations and uncertainty explanations intact.

visualIssues.detail: Forecast uses hardcoded saturated purple confidence gradient/projected line, green actual line and amber/red reference lines including bright warranty text. Risk bars use saturated hex fills with default gradient; SOH helper uses palette colors plus hardcoded red. Multiple hue systems compete.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing chart palettes and semantic tone APIs, subdue reference decoration and select existing MetricBar fill=solid where appropriate. Retain distinct actual/projected/confidence identities, labels, source thresholds and saved chart color choices; do not replace uncertainty with decoration.

visualIssues.detail: Risk factors and three health factors nest GlassPanel inside LayoutCard; summary, gauge and history repeat SOH with multiple badges. Existing repeated evidence has distinct purpose but may make every subsection equally loud.
visualIssues.fix: Evaluate rendered hierarchy and reduce nested border/elevation emphasis rather than deleting evidence, replacing the shared surface system or removing useful comparison context.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports CardGrid/useCardPlacement/CardSize directly from layout/layout-reference. BatteryDegradationStats imports StatMetric from data-display/stat-reference although data-display category already exports that type.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing category exports; shared layout owner must verify/re-export existing useCardPlacement and CardSize if absent. Do not copy layout policy/context into feature code.

architectureIssues.detail: Page retains chart joins and domain score derivations within a 770-line orchestrator. The first history row is labeled original range; response type also exposes original_capacity_wh/capacity_source but mounted page does not consume them. Exact source completeness, baseline ordering and model confidence are unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract only bounded typed feature transformations if needed, preserving existing ordering/score/joins. Make actual source/model limitations visible where available; never infer an original factory measurement, calibrated confidence or missing backend capability.

priority.rationale: Already adopts shared layout, trust, SI display formatting and mobile history details. Highest risks are forecast evidence accessibility and inconsistent retained/fatal source messaging, then decorative intensity.
priority.notClaimed: Runtime acceptance, measured battery degradation, forecast calibration, warranty validity or completed modernization

dataBehavior: Keep query identity, retry:false, ANALYTICS stale policy, signal cancellation, selected vehicle enablement and raw returned payload.
Keep inferred provenance, 24h age threshold, fatal versus refresh distinction, independent retained-source warning and initial reconnect notice.
No fake degradation evidence: absent/null/nonfinite inputs remain unknown or unavailable; no fixtures, invented confidence bounds or fabricated capacity.
Wh/meters remain SI on wire/cache. Existing preferences apply only in display formatters, chart coordinates and table labels.
Retain first-returned-history baseline and history/projection joining unless a separately verified source correction is authorized.
Retain exact confidence-low/high arithmetic and missing historical/projection gaps; future uncertainty must not be dropped during visual simplification.
Retain all risk/recommendation/source text, source thresholds and current specialist rate/age/cycle calculations.
Do not add unsupported backend date filtering, vehicle commands, full-history pagination or authentication behavior.
